test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 10 men can finish a certain task in 10 days, whereas it takes 12 women to finish it in 10 days. If 15 men and 6 women undertake to complete the task, how many days will they need to complete it?
solution:
**Given:**

10 men can finish a certain task in 10 days

12 women can finish the same task in 10 days

**Formula used:**

Work done by 1 man in 1 day = Total work / (Number of men × Number of days)

Work done by 1 woman in 1 day = Total work / (Number of women × Number of days)

Total work done by 15 men and 6 women in 1 day = (Work done by 1 man in 1 day × 15) + (Work done by 1 woman in 1 day × 6)

Number of days required to complete the task = Total work / Total work done by 15 men and 6 women in 1 day

**Calculations:**

Work done by 1 man in 1 day = 1 / (10 × 10)

⇒ Work done by 1 man in 1 day = 1 / 100

Work done by 1 woman in 1 day = 1 / (12 × 10)

⇒ Work done by 1 woman in 1 day = 1 / 120

Total work done by 15 men in 1 day = 15 × (1 / 100)

⇒ Total work done by 15 men in 1 day = 15 / 100

Total work done by 6 women in 1 day = 6 × (1 / 120)

⇒ Total work done by 6 women in 1 day = 6 / 120

⇒ Total work done by 6 women in 1 day = 1 / 20

Total work done by 15 men and 6 women in 1 day = (15 / 100) + (1 / 20)

⇒ Total work done by 15 men and 6 women in 1 day = (15 / 100) + (5 / 100)

⇒ Total work done by 15 men and 6 women in 1 day = 20 / 100

⇒ Total work done by 15 men and 6 women in 1 day = 1 / 5

Number of days required to complete the task = 1 / (1 / 5)

⇒ Number of days required to complete the task = 5 days

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
